verdict.rationale: Rippling's own docs say its identity product federates SAML and OIDC apps, so SSO app integration is a documented capability. Nothing in the pack shows a pre-built catalog, its size, or minutes-level setup, and the cited phrase stresses custom SAML apps rather than ready-made connectors. missing for 10: evidence of a pre-built SSO app catalog, catalog size (thousands of apps), connect-in-minutes setup, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the SSO catalog covers my stack — thousands of pre-built SAML/OIDC app integrations that connect in minutes, not custom projects

citations.quote: Federated identity lets you handle any protocol with ease—from LDAP, Active Directory (AD), OIDC, and RADIUS, to custom SCIM and SAML apps.
